content.text:
Based on the project history, I found the KRaft timeout-metrics design discussion from May 2026 in the email thread about KIP-1322. 

As of 2026-05-14, the decision was made to **always report the metrics regardless of state**. This decision was made by Tony Tang on 2026-05-14 00:23:32 UTC, after Kevin Wu argued on 2026-05-13 for always reporting the metrics to avoid "too late" visibility issues, even when the node's current state does not contain the timer.

This represented a change from the earlier agreement (2026-05-04) to use state-based registration/unregistration, which was reconsidered based on visibility and observability concerns.
